findings.title: The 1.017588x result is an optimistic analytical cycle opportunity, not an executable module schedule
findings.evidence: The trace/order/work and same destination-update-port accounting recompute exactly, and all 2,970 phases are compute-bound. However, the separate 96-lane signed12 miss builder, its timing/area/energy, and the ready dependency between an online fill and a later hit are not scheduled or priced. Any nonnegative correction only lowers the gain, so this does not weaken the negative decision.
findings.required_fix: Use 'optimistic ordered-trace module-cycle upper bound' in summaries. Do not call it VCS-calibrated or executable. No builder RTL is warranted because the zero-cost point already misses the frozen 1.5x gate by 595,347,420 cycles.

findings.title: The README's closure of all cache/catalog-only Patch optimization is broader than the tested policies
findings.evidence: M272 tests one frozen global K16 catalog and M274 tests one-entry per-partition online MRU. They strongly justify freezing these candidates and the current cache-only workstream under the 1.5x gate, but they do not enumerate every capacity, replacement, spatial sharing, compression, or trained patch-specific policy.
findings.required_fix: State that the tested global-K16 and online-one-entry-MRU candidates, and therefore the current Patch cache-only line, are frozen. Reopening should require a materially different, precommitted policy with an analytical upper bound above 1.5x before implementation.
